reason: The indexed monoclinic cell, Z=4, and a doubled TiNi martensitic framework are well supported by the peak positions, and the submitted model is stoichiometric with physically sensible interatomic distances. Exact recovery is not established, however: the comparable whole-pattern report supplies no score, while the trajectory's own profile tests retain roughly 0.30 relative profile R (and large reflection-intensity errors, often factors of two or more) and deliberately exclude an unexplained ~40.27 degree line. Coordinate refinements from different objectives are not stable, and the search largely imposed the P21/m mirror-plane model; it did not competitively refine lower-symmetry realizations or all inequivalent Ti/Ni site orderings, comparing mainly the submitted ordering with its global element swap. Thus the data support the cell and average framework much more strongly than the exact symmetry, coordinates, and ordering, and scientifically motivated alternative realizations could materially improve candidate coverage and fit.
